title: Emergency Response & Area Securing
current_visual_line: yellow caution hazard tape, safety cones, or barricaded hazardous area
proposed_visual_line: a hazardous emergency scene: flood water on the floor, fire or smoke, a fallen tree or collapsed structure, damaged electrical equipment or shattered glass, area closed off with caution tape or cones
why: Old line described only the barrier (tape/cones); worker photos show the hazard itself. Wording follows the service scope and keywords (fire, flooding, hazard, unsafe area, cordon off).

title: Elevator / Lift Breakdown Response
current_visual_line: Elevator doors with metallic panels, exposed control cabinet, electrical wiring, circuit boards, maintenance tools, and a service area with tiled flooring.
proposed_visual_line: elevator car or lift doors in a building lobby, lift call buttons and floor indicator, an elevator stuck with doors half open
why: Generic terms (electrical wiring, circuit boards, tiled flooring) matched electrical hazards, corridors and doors; now specific to lifts.

title: BUILDING FACADE CLEANING
current_visual_line: exterior building wall, architectural facade, or high-rise outer wall
proposed_visual_line: the outside wall of a multi-storey building seen from the ground, stained, dusty or algae-covered facade and cladding panels
why: Clarifies a ground-level view of the building's outer wall surface, distinct from rooftops and windows.

title: External Areas Cleaning
current_visual_line: outdoor pavement, walkway, or courtyard with fallen leaves and outdoor debris
proposed_visual_line: outdoor ground of a school site, a paved walkway, courtyard, playground or driveway covered with leaves, sand, mud or scattered litter
why: Emphasises the open outdoor ground surface rather than bins, to separate it from Waste Management.

title: General Areas Cleaning (Classrooms, Offices, Toilets)
current_visual_line: dirty classroom or corridor floor needing sweeping and mopping
proposed_visual_line: indoor classroom, corridor or staircase with a dusty, dirty or muddy floor that needs sweeping and mopping
why: Adds staircase/indoor context; routine floor cleaning inside the building.

title: Door / Locker Lock Assistance
current_visual_line: locked door handle, keyhole, padlock on locker or cabinet
proposed_visual_line: close-up of a locked door, metal locker or cabinet drawer with a key stuck in the lock or a padlock that will not open
why: Focus on the locked state (key in lock, closed padlock) rather than generic door hardware, which also matched handyman repairs.

title: Furniture Moving Service
current_visual_line: office desks, chairs, or tables stacked and prepared for relocation
proposed_visual_line: desks, chairs, sofas or shelves being carried or moved between rooms, furniture pushed together ready for relocation
why: Adds the act of moving and more furniture types (sofas, shelves) from the service keywords.
